digest.component_or_area: create coordination family and outbound dispatch routing
propositions: Process restart must not create duplicate Jira issues; exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding must result from crash-restart sequences.

Create dispatch must route through exactly one selector (create_route.create_route) with coordinator as default and legacy as rollback value, ensuring no dual-send across batch_dispatch, reroute_migrated_plans, and handle_create.
Dependent links and children must be held until create and binding confirmation are proven, while tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective.
Keyed recovery must perform zero search; keyless recovery must require both three misses and 3600 seconds before considering recovery exhausted.
All success, soft-404, fail-fast, landed-unconfirmed, persist-failure, and commit-unknown outcomes must maintain identical behavior between coordinated and legacy routes.
